text: Search the whole repo outside node_modules for 8px / 8 px tokens near label, using a bounded find prune over the top-level dirs.
command: cd /work && timeout 25 grep -rnE '8 ?px' platform/canvas-format platform/contracts domains tenants rules tests/e2e-ui knowledge-base apps/canvas/index.html apps/canvas/ops.html apps/canvas/work-os.html 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | grep -iE 'label|token|admin' | cut -c1-220 | head -30
